src: Muscatine News-Tribune, 26 Mar 1902, p. 1, 'Unearth a Pot of Gold' (Newspapers.com 543705318)
tw-ia-muscatine-kegel-lot-1902.st: The News-Tribune: laborers grading the old Kegel property on East Fifth Street for George Koehler; Phil Fahey's shovel struck a tin can about 20 inches down among gooseberry bushes, holding $191.30 in gold ($1 to $20 pieces) and three silver dimes, packed in a coconut shell capped with a fruit-jar lid; the lot was 'formerly occupied by Chris Kegal'.

set.pl: Old Kegel lot, East Fifth Street, Muscatine (1902); lot number not given
pinev: Muscatine city address points: E 5th St runs from no. 102 (41.4237,-91.0478) to about no. 1517 (41.4310,-91.0315); pin at the mid-point, r800 covers the whole street. The 1902 lot number is not given.
